children: 18 September 2026 – Prosafe's CEO, Reese McNeel, presented at Pareto Securities' Energy Conference this week.
The presentation is attached and has also been uploaded to Prosafe's website: www.prosafe.com.

Prosafe is a leading owner and operator of semi-submersible accommodation vessels. The company is listed on the Oslo Stock Exchange under the ticker symbol PRS. For more information, please visit www.prosafe.com.
This  information is subject to the  disclosure requirements pursuant to section
5-12 of  the Norwegian Securities Trading Act and the continuing obligations for
issuers listed on Euronext Oslo Børs.
